propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly, bypassing the self-healing retry seam that protects all other store git operations

transient object-DB read failures (missing loose objects) cause s3_doctor bundle creation to fail with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' on the CI runner, reproducible by deleting the merge commit object before bundling
routing s3_doctor._git through gitutil.run_git_write instead of raw run_git causes it to inherit per-store advisory locking, index/ref-lock retry, and transient-marker retry
the missing-object signature must be added to the transient-marker family in gitutil so existing retry logic handles this proven fault class without new retry infrastructure
S3DoctorConflict error hints misdirect operators to fsck-recover for object-DB read failures on non-conflicting merges
